label: synthetic
purpose: A seed translation of a recorded source note into the baseline definition. It has no parent, declares its source-to-draft differences and no unresolved element.

lines: Buy a liquid stock above its 50-session mean after a recent weak RSI and a rebound on rising volume.
Rank candidates by volume expansion and weakness, hold at most five, size equally.
Stop at two ATR below the entry, target at five ATR above.

claims.rationale: A stock in an established uptrend that dipped to weakness and rebounds on heavier trading tends to recover over days to weeks.
claims.expected_effect: Entries follow the rebound; evaluation can contradict this.
invalidation_conditions: Signal and trade counts do not move in the stated direction against the parent in the development window.
requested_tests: The registered comparison against the parent under the frozen policy.

source_differences.source: The note does not state when a signal fills.
source_differences.draft: Entries fill at the next session open under the declared cost model.
Ties break by ascending instrument identifier.
